name: Presentation
remarks: The Presentation object is a member of the Presentations collection. The Presentations collection contains all the Presentation objects that represent open presentations in PowerPoint. The following examples describe how to: - Return a presentation that you specify by name or index number - Return the presentation in the active window - Return the presentation in any document window or slide show window you specify

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: SlideMaster
properties.description: Returns a Master object that represents the slide master.

properties.name: TitleMaster
properties.description: Returns a Master object that represents the title master for the specified presentation.

properties.name: HasTitleMaster
properties.description: MsoTrue if the specified presentation has a title master. Read-only.

properties.name: TemplateName
properties.description: Returns the name of the first design/master associated with the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: NotesMaster
properties.description: Returns a Master object that represents the notes master. Read-only.

properties.name: HandoutMaster
properties.description: Returns a Master object that represents the handout master. Read-only.

properties.name: Slides
properties.description: Returns a Slides collection that represents all slides in the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: PageSetup
properties.description: Returns a PageSetup object whose properties control slide setup attributes for the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: ColorSchemes
properties.description: Returns a ColorSchemes collection that represents the color schemes in the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: ExtraColors
properties.description: Returns an ExtraColors object that represents the extra colors available in the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideShowSettings
properties.description: Returns a SlideShowSettings object that represents the slide show settings for the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Fonts
properties.description: Returns a Fonts collection that represents all fonts used in the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a DocumentWindows collection that represents all document windows associated with the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Tags
properties.description: Returns a Tags object that represents the tags for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: DefaultShape
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the default shape for the presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: BuiltInDocumentProperties
properties.description: Returns a DocumentProperties collection that represents all the built-in document properties for the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomDocumentProperties
properties.description: Returns a DocumentProperties collection that represents all the custom document properties for the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: VBProject
properties.description: Returns a VBProject object that represents the individual Visual Basic project for the presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Returns whether the specified presentation is read-only. Read-only.

properties.name: FullName
properties.description: Returns the name of the specified add-in or saved presentation, including the path, the current file system separator, and the file name extension. Read-only String.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The name of the presentation includes the file name extension (for file types that are registered) but doesn't include its path. You cannot use this property to set the name. Use the SaveAs method to save the presentation under a different name if you need to change the name. Read-only.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the path to the specified Presentation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Saved
properties.description: Determines whether changes have been made to a presentation since it was last saved. Read/write.

properties.name: LayoutDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the layout direction for the user interface. Read/write.

properties.name: PrintOptions
properties.description: Returns a PrintOptions object that represents print options that are saved with the specified presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: Container
properties.description: Returns the object that contains the specified embedded presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayComments
properties.description: Determines whether comments are displayed in the specified presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets the line break based upon Asian character level. Read/write.

properties.name: NoLineBreakBefore
properties.description: Returns or sets the characters that cannot begin a line. Read/write.

properties.name: NoLineBreakAfter
properties.description: Returns or sets the characters that cannot end a line. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideShowWindow
properties.description: Returns a SlideShowWindow object that represents the slide show window in which the specified presentation is running. Read-only.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakLanguage
properties.description: Returns or sets the language used to determine which line break level is used when the line break control option is turned on. Read/write.

properties.name: DefaultLanguageID
properties.description: Returns or sets the default language of presentations. Read/write.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars collection that represents the merged command bar set from the host container application and Microsoft PowerPoint. This property returns a valid object only when the container is a DocObject server, like Microsoft Binder, and PowerPoint is acting as an OLE server. Read-only.

properties.name: EnvelopeVisible
properties.description: Determines whether the email message header is visible in the document window. Read/write.

properties.name: VBASigned
properties.description: Determines whether the Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) project for the specified document has been digitally signed. Read-only.

properties.name: SnapToGrid
properties.description: Determines whether to snap shapes to the gridlines in the specified presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: GridDistance
properties.description: Sets or returns a Single that represents the distance between gridlines. Read/write.

properties.name: Designs
properties.description: Returns a Designs object that represents a collection of designs.

properties.name: Signatures
properties.description: Returns a SignatureSet object that represents a collection of digital signatures. Read-only.

properties.name: RemovePersonalInformation
properties.description: Determines whether Microsoft PowerPoint should remove all user information from comments and revisions upon saving a presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionProvider
properties.description: Returns the name of the algorithm encryption provider that Microsoft PowerPoint uses when it encrypts documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm
properties.description: Returns the algorithm Microsoft PowerPoint uses for encrypting documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionKeyLength
properties.description: Returns the key length of the algorithm Microsoft PowerPoint uses when it encrypts documents with passwords. Read-only.

properties.name: PasswordEncryptionFileProperties
properties.description: Returns whether Microsoft PowerPoint encrypts file properties for password-protected documents. Read-only.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: Returns or sets the password that must be supplied to open the specified presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: WritePassword
properties.description: Sets or returns the password for saving changes to the specified document. Read/write.

properties.name: DocumentLibraryVersions
properties.description: Returns a DocumentLibraryVersions collection that represents the collection of versions of a shared presentation that has versioning enabled and that is stored in a document library on a server.

properties.name: ContentTypeProperties
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Office MetaProperties collection that describes the metadata stored in the presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: ServerPolicy
properties.description: Returns a Microsoft Office ServerPolicy object. Read-only.

properties.name: DocumentInspectors
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Office DocumentInspectors collection. Read-only.

properties.name: HasVBProject
properties.description: Returns whether the active presentation contains a Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) project. Read-only.

properties.name: CustomXMLParts
properties.description: Returns a CustomXMLParts object that represents the collection of custom XML parts associated with the specified Presentation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Final
properties.description: Determines whether the presentation is marked as final (read-only). Read/write.

properties.name: CustomerData
properties.description: Returns a CustomerData object. Read-only.

properties.name: Research
properties.description: Returns a Research object that provides access to the research service feature of Microsoft PowerPoint. Read-only.

properties.name: EncryptionProvider
properties.description: Returns a String that specifies the name of the algorithm encryption provider that PowerPoint uses when encrypting documents. Read/write.

properties.name: SectionProperties
properties.description: Returns a SectionProperties object. Read-only.

properties.name: Coauthoring
properties.description: Returns a Coauthoring object in the current Presentation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Broadcast
properties.description: Returns the Broadcast object of the current Presentation object. Read-only.

properties.name: HasNotesMaster
properties.description: Indicates whether the presentation has media that resides on a notes master. Read-only.

properties.name: HasHandoutMaster
properties.description: Indicates whether the presentation has media that resides on a handout master. Read-only

properties.name: CreateVideoStatus
properties.description: Returns the status of creating a video in the current Presentation. Read-only.

properties.name: ChartDataPointTrack
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that specifies whether charts use cell-reference data-point tracking. Read/write.

properties.name: Guides
properties.description: Returns the Guides collection associated with a custom layout. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoSaveOn
properties.description: True if the edits in the presentation are automatically saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReadOnlyRecommended
properties.description: True if the presentation was saved as read-only recommended. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: SensitivityLabel
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Office SensitivityLabel object from the Presentation.

properties.name: IsFullyDownloaded
properties.description: True if the presentation has finished downloading all of the content. Read-only Boolean.

methods.name: AddTitleMaster

methods.description: Adds a title master to the specified presentation and returns a Master object that represents the title master.

methods.name: ApplyTemplate
methods.signature: ApplyTemplate(FileName As String)
methods.description: Applies a design template to the specified presentation.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the design template.

methods.name: NewWindow
methods.signature: NewWindow() As DocumentWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window that contains the specified presentation. Returns a DocumentWindow object that represents the new window.

methods.name: FollowHyperlink
methods.signature: FollowHyperlink(Address As String, [SubAddress As String], [NewWindow As Boolean], [AddHistory As Boolean], [ExtraInfo As String], [Method As MsoExtraInfoMethod], [HeaderInfo As String])
methods.description: Displays a cached document, if it has already been downloaded. Otherwise, this method resolves the hyperlink, downloads the target document and displays it in the appropriate application.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The address of the target document.

parameters.name: SubAddress
parameters.description: The location in the target document. By default, this argument is an empty string.

parameters.name: NewWindow
parameters.description: True to have the target application opened in a new window. The default value is False.

parameters.name: AddHistory
parameters.description: True to add the link to the current day's history folder.

parameters.name: ExtraInfo
parameters.description: String or byte array that specifies information for HTTP. This argument can be used, for example, to specify the coordinates of an image map or the contents of a form. It can also indicate a FAT file name. The Method argument determines how this extra information is handled.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: Specifies how ExtraInfo is posted or appended.

parameters.name: HeaderInfo
parameters.description: A string that specifies header information for the HTTP request. The default value is an empty string. You can combine several header lines into a single string by using the following syntax: "string1" & vbCr & "string2". The specified string is automatically converted into ANSI characters. Note that the HeaderInfo argument may overwrite default HTTP header fields.

methods.name: AddToFavorites
methods.signature: AddToFavorites()
methods.description: Adds a shortcut that represents the current selection in the specified presentation to the Windows Favorites folder.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([From As Long], [To As Long], [PrintToFile As String], [Copies As Long], [Collate As MsoTriState])
methods.description: Prints the specified presentation.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the first page to be printed. If this argument is omitted, printing starts at the beginning of the presentation. Specifying the To and From arguments sets the contents of the PrintRanges object and sets the value of the RangeType property for the presentation.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last page to be printed. If this argument is omitted, printing continues to the end of the presentation. Specifying the To and From arguments sets the contents of the PrintRanges object and sets the value of the RangeType property for the presentation.

parameters.name: PrintToFile
parameters.description: The name of the file to print to. If you specify this argument, the file is printed to a file rather than sent to a printer. If this argument is omitted, the file is sent to a printer.

parameters.name: Copies
parameters.description: The number of copies to be printed. If this argument is omitted, only one copy is printed. Specifying this argument sets the value of the NumberOfCopiesproperty.

parameters.name: Collate
parameters.description: If this argument is omitted, multiple copies are collated. Specifying this argument sets the value of the Collate property.

methods.name: Save
methods.signature: Save()
methods.description: Saves the specified presentation.

methods.name: SaveAs
methods.signature: SaveAs(FileName As String, [FileFormat As PpSaveAsFileType], [EmbedTrueTypeFonts As MsoTriState])
methods.description: Saves a presentation that's never been saved, or saves a previously saved presentation under a different name.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the name to save the file under. If you don't include a full path, PowerPoint saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: FileFormat
parameters.description: Specifies the saved file format. If this argument is omitted, the file is saved in the default file format (ppSaveAsDefault).

methods.name: SaveCopyAs
methods.signature: SaveCopyAs(FileName As String, [FileFormat As PpSaveAsFileType], [EmbedTrueTypeFonts As MsoTriState])
methods.description: Saves a copy of the specified presentation to a file without modifying the original.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the name to save the file under. If you don't include a full path, PowerPoint saves the file in the current folder.

parameters.name: FileFormat
parameters.description: The file format.

parameters.name: EmbedTrueTypeFonts
parameters.description: Specifies whether TrueType fonts are embedded.

methods.name: Export
methods.signature: Export(Path As String, FilterName As String, [ScaleWidth As Long], [ScaleHeight As Long])
methods.description: Exports each slide in the presentation, using the specified graphics filter, and saves the exported files in the specified folder.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path of the folder where you want to save the exported slides. You can include a full path; if you don't do this, Microsoft PowerPoint creates a subfolder in the current folder for the exported slides.

parameters.name: FilterName
parameters.description: The graphics format in which you want to export slides. The specified graphics format must have an export filter registered in the Windows registry. You can specify either the registered extension or the registered filter name. PowerPoint will first search for a matching extension in the registry. If no extension that matches the specified string is found, PowerPoint will look for a filter name that matches.

parameters.name: ScaleWidth
parameters.description: The width in pixels of an exported slide.

parameters.name: ScaleHeight
parameters.description: The height in pixels of an exported slide.

methods.name: Close
methods.signature: Close()
methods.description: Closes the specified presentation.

methods.name: UpdateLinks
methods.signature: UpdateLinks()
methods.description: Updates linked OLE objects in the specified presentation.

methods.name: CheckIn
methods.signature: CheckIn([SaveChanges As Boolean], [Comments As Variant], [MakePublic As Variant])
methods.description: Returns a presentation from a local computer to a server, and sets the local file to read-only so that it cannot be edited locally.

parameters.name: SaveChanges
parameters.description: True saves the presentation to the server location. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description: Comments for the revision of the presentation being checked in (only applies if SaveChanges equals True).

parameters.name: MakePublic
parameters.description: True allows the user to perform a publish on the presentation after being checked in. This submits the document for the approval process, which can eventually result in a version of the presentation being published to users with read-only rights to the presentation (only applies if SaveChanges equals True).

methods.name: CanCheckIn
methods.signature: CanCheckIn() As Boolean
methods.description: Returns True if Microsoft PowerPoint can check in a specified presentation to a server.

methods.name: SetPasswordEncryptionOptions
methods.signature: SetPasswordEncryptionOptions(PasswordEncryptionProvider As String, PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm As String, PasswordEncryptionKeyLength As Long, PasswordEncryptionFileProperties As Boolean)
methods.description: Sets the options Microsoft PowerPoint uses for encrypting presentations with passwords.

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionProvider
parameters.description: The name of the encryption provider.

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionAlgorithm
parameters.description: The name of the encryption algorithm. PowerPoint supports stream-encrypted algorithms.

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionKeyLength
parameters.description: The encryption key length. Must be a multiple of 8, starting at 40.

parameters.name: PasswordEncryptionFileProperties
parameters.description: msoTrue for PowerPoint to encrypt file properties.

methods.name: SendFaxOverInternet
methods.signature: SendFaxOverInternet([Recipients As String], [Subject As String], [ShowMessage As Boolean])
methods.description: Sends a presentation as a fax to the specified recipients.

parameters.name: Recipients
parameters.description: A String that represents the fax numbers and email addresses of the people to whom to send the fax. Separate multiple recipients with a semicolon.

parameters.name: Subject
parameters.description: A String that represents the subject line for the faxed presentation.

parameters.name: ShowMessage
parameters.description: Whether to display the fax message before sending it. True displays the fax message before sending it. False sends the fax without displaying the fax message.

methods.name: RemoveDocumentInformation

methods.description: Removes document information, such as personal information, comments, and document properties, from a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation.

parameters.name: Type

methods.name: CheckInWithVersion

methods.description: Returns a presentation from a local computer to a server, and sets the local file to read-only so that it cannot be edited locally.

parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description: Comments for the revision of the presentation being checked in (only applies if SaveChanges equals True).

parameters.name: MakePublic
parameters.description: True allows the user to perform a publish on the presentation after being checked in. This submits the document for the approval process, which can eventually result in a version of the presentation being published to users with read-only rights to the presentation (only applies if SaveChanges equals True).

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(Path As String, FixedFormatType As PpFixedFormatType, [Intent As PpFixedFormatIntent], [FrameSlides As MsoTriState], [HandoutOrder As PpPrintHandoutOrder], [OutputType As PpPrintOutputType], [PrintHiddenSlides As MsoTriState], [PrintRange As PrintRange], [RangeType As PpPrintRangeType], [SlideShowName As String], [IncludeDocProperties As Boolean], [KeepIRMSettings As Boolean], [DocStructureTags As Boolean], [BitmapMissingFonts As Boolean], [UseISO19005_1 As Boolean], [ExternalExporter As Variant])

parameters.description: The format to which the slides should be exported.

parameters.description: Whether the slides to be exported should be bordered by a frame.

parameters.name: HandoutOrder

parameters.name: OutputType

parameters.name: PrintHiddenSlides

parameters.name: PrintRange

parameters.name: RangeType
parameters.description: The type of slide range.

parameters.name: SlideShowName

parameters.name: IncludeDocProperties
parameters.description: Whether the document properties should also be exported. The default is False.

parameters.name: KeepIRMSettings

parameters.name: DocStructureTags

parameters.name: BitmapMissingFonts
parameters.description: Whether to include a bitmap of the text. The default is True.

parameters.name: ExternalExporter
parameters.description: A pointer to an Office add-in that implements the IMsoDocExporter COM interface and allows calls to an alternate implementation of code. The default is a null pointer.

methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat3(Path As String, FixedFormatType As PpFixedFormatType, [Intent As PpFixedFormatIntent], [FrameSlides As MsoTriState], [HandoutOrder As PpPrintHandoutOrder], [OutputType As PpPrintOutputType], [PrintHiddenSlides As MsoTriState], [PrintRange As PrintRange], [RangeType As PpPrintRangeType], [SlideShowName As String], [IncludeDocProperties As Boolean], [KeepIRMSettings As Boolean], [DocStructureTags As Boolean], [BitmapMissingFonts As Boolean], [UseISO19005_1 As Boolean], [IncludeMarkup As Boolean], [Bookmarks As Boolean], [DocumentMarkup As Boolean], [PromotedHyperlinkShape As Boolean], [ExternalExporter As Variant])
methods.description: Publishes a copy of a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation as a file in a fixed format, either PDF or XPS.

parameters.name: Path

parameters.name: FixedFormatType

parameters.name: DocStructureTags
parameters.description: Whether to include document structure tags to improve document accessibility. The default is True.

parameters.name: BitmapMissingFonts
parameters.description: Whether to include a bitmap of the text. The default is True.

parameters.name: UseISO19005_1
parameters.description: Whether the resulting document is compliant with ISO 19005-1 (PDF/A). The default is False.

parameters.name: IncludeMarkup
parameters.description: Whether the resulting document should include associated pen marks.

parameters.name: Bookmarks
parameters.description: Whether bookmarks for each section and slide should be included in the exported document. When using this option, external exporters should not add their own bookmarks for sections or slides. The default is True.

parameters.name: DocumentMarkup
parameters.description: Whether the Document tag should be included in the document structure tags. When using this option, external exporters should not add their own Document tag. The default is True.

parameters.name: PromotedHyperlinkShape
parameters.description: Whether hyperlinks should be promoted to siblings of objects rather than nested within objects in document structure tags. Transparent text elements with alpha of 0 are included for the hyperlinks and external exporters should respect the alpha value so that they are not visible in the document. The default is True.

parameters.name: ExternalExporter
parameters.description: A pointer to an Office add-in that implements the IMsoDocExporter COM interface and allows calls to an alternate implementation of code. The default is a null pointer.
